staffPin.title: Staff PIN sign-in
staffPin.noDevice: Ask your manager to sign in on this device first. After that, staff can sign in here with just their PIN.

select.title: Choose where to work
select.subtitle: Pick the store or role you want to use in this browser.
select.grantHint: Requests are reviewed by the store admin (staff) or a system administrator. Approved roles appear here as a card.

context.switchFailed: Could not switch. The access may have been removed — the list has been refreshed.

confirm.title: Switch context?
confirm.deviceMessage: This device is set up as the POS for {{device}}. Switching to {{target}} affects every tab in this browser. Finish any payment or printing in progress first.

switchedElsewhere.title: Switched in another tab
switchedElsewhere.message: This browser moved to a different context in another tab. This screen will follow. Check that no payment or ticket was in progress.

revoked.title: Access removed
revoked.message: Your access to that store was removed. You are back to your own account — pick where to work.

deviceMismatch.title: Different store on this device
deviceMismatch.message: This device is set up as the POS for {{device}}, but your session is in another store. Switch back before using the counter screens.

admin.title: Store & brand access (contexts)
admin.hint: Grant this user access to another store (as store admin or owner) or to a brand (as brand manager — menus, recipes, reports; not payment settings or brand ownership). They can switch into it after logging in. Revoking takes effect on their next request — they are returned to their own account, not logged out.
admin.revokeConfirmMessage: {{name}} access will be removed. If they are working in that store right now, they will be returned to their own account.

request.title: Request a role
request.typeStoreStaffHint: The store admin sets your permissions when approving.
request.searchPlaceholder: Type at least 2 letters of the name

requests.title: Role requests
requests.pendingAlert: {{count}} role request(s) waiting — click to review
